Indian firms invest in data centers amid AI boom

Indian infrastructure companies are increasing investments in data centers to support the nation's artificial intelligence boom. Five listed firms are identified as building the backbone for this growth, spanning areas from server provision to power supply. This surge in investment is driven by the expanding demand for data processing and storage capabilities necessary for AI development and deployment within India.
